Projects.title: Profil Web Desa Keseneng
desc: A village profile website for Desa Keseneng at desakeseneng.id, designed to present village identity, public information, local potential, and community activities in one accessible digital channel.

The site is structured as a public-facing profile so visitors can quickly understand the village location, administrative context, tourism appeal, local economy, and social life without searching through scattered posts or informal channels.

Content planning focuses on the real character of Desa Keseneng in Kecamatan Sumowono, Kabupaten Semarang, including its rural landscape, agricultural and livestock activity, community organizations, and tourism potential such as Curug 7 Bidadari and Curug Palebur Gongso.

The information architecture separates important village content into clear sections: village overview, government profile, regional potential, public services, news or activity updates, gallery, and contact access. This makes the website useful for residents, visitors, village officials, and external partners.

For the portfolio implementation, the project highlights practical web development work beyond a simple landing page: arranging dense profile content, building readable responsive layouts, preparing navigation for long-form information, and keeping the site easy to maintain as village data grows.

The project also supports digital transparency by giving the village a professional online presence where announcements, program documentation, tourism promotion, and local product information can be published more consistently.

On the user experience side, the layout prioritizes scanning and clarity. Visitors should be able to move from an introduction to detailed information, discover village potential, and reach contact or location information without friction on mobile or desktop.

This project is a good example of a community-oriented web profile: the value is not only visual presentation, but also organizing local knowledge into a web experience that can support administration, promotion, and public communication.

Projects.title: TokoManagement
desc: A store management web app that centralizes inventory, supplier, customer, and order workflows so owners can track daily operations without juggling spreadsheets.
Built with Laravel and Vue for fast CRUD and responsive UI, backed by MySQL and Dockerized pipelines on GitLab CI/CD to keep deployments reliable.

Projects.title: WHAStore
desc: WHAStore is a web e-commerce platform with a Go backend and Next.js frontend, using Zod to keep catalog, cart, and checkout flows consistently validated.
Midtrans powers payments, while PostgreSQL and Redis handle persistence and caching. Everything is Dockerized with GitLab CI/CD so releases stay fast and repeatable.

Projects.title: Avocycle
desc: A farmer-facing web app to manage avocado production - from tracking growers and plots to logging harvests and coordinating supply with buyers.
Built with React, Tailwind CSS, and Axios for a responsive dashboard that keeps farmer data, inventory, and order status clear and actionable.

Projects.title: Predict Goal
desc: A Python-based project that trains Random Forest and KNN models on two Premier League seasons to predict total match goals.
Backend runs on Flask and is deployed to Railway, while Streamlit with HTML/CSS fronts the prediction UI so users can test scenarios directly in the browser.

Projects.title: Sarponesia
desc: A company profile site for a coffee producer, showcasing the business story, product lineup, and pricing to support promotion and customer inquiries.
Built with Laravel and MySQL to keep content manageable and product data structured.

Projects.title: SIMKLINIK UI/UX
desc: Designed the UI/UX for a veterinary clinic management system, focusing on clear flows for appointments, patient records, and billing.
Prototyped in Figma to keep handoff smooth for frontend implementation.
